1115-5078-5243-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4694-6258-7306-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-6258-7306-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

1981-2034-2415-6752.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2034-2415-6752.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

280-6628-7857.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

104-2034-3490-7818.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2034-3490-7818.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

670-1619-2921-3175-4681.easyPrerequisites: Sefris' first ability hasn't triggered this turn.
670-1619-2921-3175-4681.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in the second to last room of any dungeon.
670-1619-2921-3175-4681.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Sefris' first ability triggers, causing you to venture into the final room of a dungeon, causing you to complete the dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Sefris and Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sefris trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into the Cave Entrace room, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into either available room.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Sefris from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sefris enters, Radiant Solar triggers, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into any available room.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.
670-1619-2921-3175-4681.notes: You may instead execute this combo by venturing into Tomb of Annihilation instead of Lost Mine of Phandelver.

4496-5220-6559-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, sacrificing itself.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1270-1563-2457-5434.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three creature tokens.
Activate two tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1170-5195-7420-7517.description:
Cast the copy of the spell from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Molten-Core Maestro, Storm-Kiln Artist, and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Campus Composer, which enters prepared.
Resolve the Molten-Core Maestro trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding the one non-red mana you need to cast the spell from step 1.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1018-1987-4276-7487.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1018-1987-4276-7487.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Zealous Lorecaster and Skullwinder.
When Zealous Lorecaster and Skullwinder enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-4276-7487.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2049-3259-7175.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2049-3259-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-4365-5220-6351-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4365-5220-6351-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Teval triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

140-2438-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
140-2438-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: You've lost X or more life this turn.
140-2438-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
140-2438-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1525-3908-4254-7115-7117.easyPrerequisites:
You have a nonland card in hand.
You have not resolved either a firebending ability, a waterbending ability, and/or an airbending ability this turn.
1525-3908-4254-7115-7117.description:
Cast any spell by paying {0} due to Jodah and Aang, Master of Elements.
Toph triggers, earthbending a land.
Spark Double triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card and put it into your hand due to Abundance.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1, and repeat from step 1 as able.
1525-3908-4254-7115-7117.notes: You need to have both an Avatar Aang and an Aang, Master of Elements on the battlefield. This combo only reduces the mana cost of spells to {0} - it doesn't negate additional costs or targets those spells may require.

1119-2073-4241.description:
Activate Tree of Tales by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Tree of Tales to become a creature until end of turn.
Tree of Tales dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Tree of Tales from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

147-313-413.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-313-413.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Corpse Dance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

5147-5968-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

628-6487-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Canker Abomination.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, and repeat from step 1.

3875-5702-5954-6441.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3875-5702-5954-6441.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3875-5702-5954-6441.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner each trigger twice.
Resolve both Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

488-641-1492-2478-4986.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of either Mishra's Bauble or Welding Jar must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-1492-2478-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

851-2972-5456.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Treasures.
851-2972-5456.description:
Activate Magda by sacrificing three Treasures, creating two 4/4 Scorpion Dragon creature tokens with flying and haste.
When the Scorpion Dragons enter the battlefield, Ganax triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Repeat.

3821-5626--29.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{B}{B}.
3821-5626--29.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{B}{B}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Peregrine Drake and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, giving you {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 1  or less and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield. 
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, giving you {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.
If the five lands can tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

712-1562-5137.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Morphling that is an artifact.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by paying {U}, untapping it.
Wake Thrasher triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

1350-2713-3263-4617.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin twice by paying {2}, giving any two creatures trample until end of turn.
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}, giving any creature trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {1}, returning Soulbright Flamekin from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Soulbright Flamekin twice by paying {2}.
Repeat.

520-1548-2408-5178.notablePrerequisites: An opponent that is unable to block and kill Port Razer controls a planeswalker with three or less loyalty counters on it.
520-1548-2408-5178.description:
Activate Kiora's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, preventing all damage done to and done by an opponent's planeswalker with three or less loyalty counters on it until your next turn.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Odric triggers, giving creatures you control haste, trample and trample over planeswalkers until end of turn.
Declare Port Razer as an attacker, attacking the planeswalker targeted by Kiora in step 1.
Deal combat damage to the planeswalker's controller due to Port Razer's trample over planeswalkers.
Port Razer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

628-2060-4050.description:
If Crystalline Crawler has a +1/+1 counter on it, activate its first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 until Crystalline Crawler has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crystalline Crawler, adding one mana of any color.
Crystalline Crawler dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1912-3552-4474-5153.notablePrerequisites:
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
1912-3552-4474-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {W}.
Pay {W} to create a 1/1 Warrior token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
